verdict: No blocking defect; 2 medium, 3 low — addressed

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The real iPhone flow works: share sheet opens and offers «Drucken»
doubts.disproof_attempt: All automated checks stub navigator.share/canShare; real Safari behaviour unproven.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Manual check on a real iPhone.
doubts.disposition: accepted: the user tests on a real iPhone right after deploy (requires-physical-device); recorded as the open verification step in the ADR/summary

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Every iPhone UA behaves like Safari
doubts.disproof_attempt: Chrome/Firefox on iOS and in-app WebViews match; where canShare is false they get a blob tab that may stay blank without a toast.
doubts.disposition: accepted as documented limit: recent Chrome on iOS supports file sharing and takes the share route; in-app browsers are not a target (the midwife uses Safari)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Share rejection is handled by a single follow-up
doubts.disproof_attempt: A second tap rejects with InvalidStateError and opened an extra tab.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The toast's «Speichern» recovery works on iOS
doubts.disproof_attempt: downloadPdf revokes immediately; Speichern disabled when fileName null.
doubts.disposition: accepted: user confirmed saving works on iPhone; an invoice can only be generated with both names, so fileName is set whenever Drucken is reachable

doubts.claim_under_doubt: 60 s is enough for the fallback tab
doubts.disproof_attempt: Safari may reload a discarded background tab after the URL was revoked.
doubts.disposition: accepted: rare, recoverable by tapping again
